instr: Form filling: copy a record into a form, following the special rules shown with it.
clue: Fill in the form on the right from the record on the left. Copy names and numbers exactly. Read the special rules first: a rule applies only when its condition is true for this record. Help shows the formats. Press Submit when you are done. Press Start when ready.
help_text: Date: day.month.year with dots, e.g. 05.11.1987. Numbers: digits only, no letters. Plan and contact: choose one. Leave a field empty only if a rule says so.
rules: If the person was born in {year} or later, choose the Junior plan, whatever the record says.
If the amount is more than 500, enter 500.
If the record has no phone number, leave Phone empty and choose Post as the contact.
If the postcode has only 4 digits, add a 0 at the front.
If the member number ends in 7, write the family name in CAPITAL letters.
